qualifications.detail: Sealed test catalogs qip-test-horizon-a4-path, qip-test-id-a4-complete reuse the public Markov dynamics (transition matrix, active-edge pattern, urgencies) of training catalogs; only their request types are fresh. Fully fresh test catalogs: qip-test-topology-a6-ring, qip-test-scale-a8-sparse.
A validation catalog reuses a development catalog's public dynamics; Stage 26-27 validation was not fully independent for that catalog.

not_claimed: general quantum advantage beyond the certified XOR request family and tested resource models
